events.title: On the Ground in Gaza
events.description: Join us for a panel discussion, “On the Ground in Gaza,” featuring three Palestinian-American physicians from Michigan: Dr. Yamaan Saadeh, Dr. Jiab Suleiman, and Dr. Ahmad Hasan. events.title: XPRESSIONS 2027
events.description:
ASA presents to you our BIGGEST event of the year! This year, we are proud to reveal our theme, “جذورنا,” which means “Our Roots”. Our roots tell the stories of the generations that came before us, and the cultures that continue to shape who we are today. Through our cultural expression, we honor the beauty of our Arab heritage, the strength of our communities, and the connections that keep us grounded no matter how far we grow.

With that being said, we invite you to join us for an unforgettable night at our annual Arab Xpressions show on Saturday, January 23rd, 2027, at the Michigan Theater!

TICKET INFORMATION

Round 1: $16 (Can only be bought through an ASA board member)

Round 2: $18 (Can only be bought through an ASA board member)

Round 3: $20 (Available through an ASA board member or the Michigan Theater)

The first two rounds of tickets are presale only and can be purchased exclusively through an ASA board member. Keep an eye on our community chat for ticket sale dates and board member office hours!

These discounted prices won’t last, so make sure to secure your tickets early!!
